content: Fuŋnaonecteaŋ fowarehuc juwec, eme hazeczi manambeŋ â šâŋe-nâŋeczi honembeŋ, erâ hone dendeŋnehuc mezi ba bâuac ecnembeŋ, i juju sanaŋte Micdâŋ hâcne.
Juju fârine fua tâcneme honembeŋte juju sanaŋte biŋedâŋ hâcne mufuarâ ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ. Juju sanaŋ i Mamactao fowarehuc juku nâŋerao fomârâŋkewec.

Ine hâcne wiac hone manac embeŋ ijaha ŋoŋe wâc ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋazapene manapie miriŋ-nâŋec fuame mocjaha junaŋte hâcne mueŋgopeneŋ. Eme miriŋ babac-nâŋec i Mamac â Ŋokâ-ticne Jesu Kristo erao qâsiŋnerâ foekac.
Iŋuc fuame bubiaŋ-nâŋec fua ɋârâŋke taraocte papia ši hâcne qâreŋke-ŋarekopac.
Tatamacko juhuc sâqocnere hehesoŋ mi bajuzo
Dâŋ biŋe Jesuraonec kecšiŋuc manambeŋte ŋazaeŋgopeneŋ: Anutu e tatamac, dapâc i erao moc mi fohuŋgaŋkekac.
Nâŋâc dapâcko juhuc Anuturao qohotaŋgopeneŋ mupene burec eocmu â dâŋ fâri qizecne mi bajunaŋmu.
E jahacne tatamacko jukac iŋuc jaha wâc nâŋâc tatamacko junaŋmu, ine miriŋ babac sâcne enaŋmu, eme Ŋokâ-ticne Jesu Kristo ere soczi sâqocne-nâŋec šureme ɋaɋackenaŋmu.
Nâŋâc sâqocne-nâŋec mi fokac, iŋuc munaŋmuo maŋnâŋec eatuckenaŋmu â dâŋ fâri qizecne maŋnâŋecko mi foocmu.
Á sâqocne-nâŋec mufuanaŋmuo ine e mume sasanaŋ â tiŋne runezi sâqocne-nâŋec šurehuc bahac-nâŋec nâwoc rofâreocmu.
Nâŋâc sâqocne mi baeŋgopeneŋ, iŋuc mupene Anutu burecŋic mucneŋgopeneŋ eocmu â dâŋticne maŋnâŋecko mi foocmu.
